summary: Speed restrictions of up to 250 knots for aircraft being sequenced at Birmingham Airport, falling to 165 knots on final approach.
text:
PILOTS SHOULD EXPECT THE FOLLOWING ENFORCED SPEED RESTRICTIONS AT 
BIRMINGHAM AD WHEN ACFT ARE BEING SEQUENCED. SPEED LIMIT POINT 250KT 
OR LESS INTERMEDIATE APCH AREA/DOWNWIND 210KT OR LESS BASE/15NM FM 
TOUCHDOWN 180KT OR LESS FINAL APPROACH BTN 8 DME AND 5 DME 165KT
